results.title: What Is Claude AI? - IBM
results.content: Claude is a family of proprietary [large language models (LLMs)](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/large-language-models), as well an AI assistant and other AI tools powered by those models, developed by Anthropic. Claude models, particularly from their third generation onward, have consistently ranked among the top performing [generative AI](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/generative-ai) models available on the market. While Claude models are all multilingual and [multimodal](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/multimodal-ai), their functionality is primarily text-based. Claude models are fully closed and proprietary to Anthropic, meaning one can only use Claude directly through Anthropic’s AI chatbot offerings—available at [Claude.ai](https://claude.ai/login) or in app form for iOS and Android—or in third-party applications that access the models through Anthropic’s [API](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/api), such as Microsoft Copilot. * The “new” Claude 3.5 Sonnet was succeeded by Claude 3.7 Sonnet, the company’s first [reasoning model](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/reasoning-model). The function of Claude’s Constitution is to quite literally inform how the model responds to specific scenarios and implements Anthropic’s core values, during both [training](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/model-training) and [inference](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/ai-inference).
